QF.id: Cat III AIF Due Diligence and Risk_18

question.text: A Cat III AIF's investor should assess 'Track Record Consistency' over:

answer.text: Full market cycle (up and down markets) ideally 5+ years

explanation.text: The Logic: Full-cycle track record (5+ years covering ups and downs) gives reliable consistency indication. The Trap: Short-horizon data can mislead. Cross-Exam Context: DD best practice.
